name: Proposals for decisions
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union agencies for the financial year 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how 33 European Union agencies spent their 2024 budgets, and closes their accounts for that year. It also sets out what the agencies should do better. The auditors found the accounts reliable and most spending legal, but flagged weak procurement as the main source of errors. Parliament asks agencies to fix problems with contracts, late payments, money carried over to the next year, cybersecurity, conflicts of interest and staffing.

- Parliament grants budget discharge to 33 agencies for 2024 and closes their accounts.
- Agencies must fix procurement, late payments, carry-overs, cybersecurity and conflicts of interest.
- Agencies report back on corrective actions; Parliament can postpone future discharge if reforms fail.
